results.title: ‘I am stunned’ – How Roger Clemens reacted to Presidential Medal of Freedom news from Donald Trump
results.description: Former MLB player Roger Clemens is now set to receive the Presidential Medal of Freedom. The Presidential Medal of Freedom is the joint-highest civilian award in the United States, and Clemens found out he was being given the honour during a rally in San Antonio, Texas, on October 7.
